BL-1789 — A vanished role session names how its agent ended - every generated launch script records its agent's start and exit (status and time) in .swarmforge/agent-lifecycle/<role>.jsonl, and babysitterd's session-missing CRIT appends the role's newest entry: the exit it recorded, a start with no exit after it, or that no entry was readable; key, severity, repair and the existing message prefix unchanged
What it solves: ## Why
Approval context: New feature file, no choice asked. FIRM: every launch records its agent's start and exit, and the session-missing CRIT names the newest record. That includes what reaches the operator, because the ESCALATED line carries the CRIT message verbatim. FIRM: the CRIT keeps its text as a prefix, its key, …
BL-1789 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1789" (or "reject BL-1789 <reason>") to act.
